description: Every AI model handyai.news has covered in a Model Drop, newest first: model name and ID, maker, date, pricing, the one-line "reach for it when", the canonical URL, a shareable card image URL and a citation. Use this as a reference index of new and historical model releases (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Kimi and more), then call get_model_card for the full card.

maker.description: Only drops from this maker, e.g. "Anthropic", "OpenAI", "Google", "xAI". Case-insensitive, partial match.

query.description: Only drops whose model name, ID or maker matches these words, e.g. "claude opus" or "grok".

name: list_model_drops
title: List Model Drops (model reference)
